title: SOA: Open Item Availability from Agent panel
summary: The Sales Order Agent can now open the multi-item availability page from the agent panel with filters applied. The availability page was extended, an Item table extension was added, and the agent instructions were updated.
key_points: Item availability can be opened from the Sales Order Agent panel with filters set by the agent
SOA Multi Items Availability page substantially extended
New table extension SOA Item Ext on the item table
Small changes to SOA Item Search and SOA Session Filter
Agent instructions prompt updated and shortened
quote: Open Item Availability page with filters from agent
